```text
8	    # RPi 4 can run a 64-bit kernel (aarch64) with 32-bit userland (armhf).

10	    # downloading aarch64 binaries that cannot execute.  Detect the real
11	    # userland architecture and expose it as target_architecture for all roles.
12	    # Note: set_fact cannot reliably override ansible_facts['architecture']
13	    # when inject_facts_as_vars=False, so we use a dedicated variable instead.
14	    - name: Detect userland architecture via dpkg
15	      ansible.builtin.command: dpkg --print-architecture
16	      register: dpkg_arch_result
17	      changed_when: false
18	      failed_when: false
19	      tags: [always]
20	
21	    - name: Set target_architecture from dpkg
```

```text
### **atuin** → Default-On
```

```text
26	# (added below); here we just ensure the binary exists.
27	
28	- name: Check if atuin is installed (Linux)
29	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
30	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
31	    set -o pipefail
32	    command -v atuin || test -x "$HOME/.atuin/bin/atuin"
33	  args:
34	    executable: /bin/bash
35	  register: atuin_check
36	  changed_when: false
37	  failed_when: false
38	  environment:

40	
41	- name: Install atuin via official installer (Linux, user-level — no sudo)
42	  when:
43	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
44	    - atuin_check.rc != 0
45	  block:
46	    - name: Install atuin via setup.atuin.sh (--non-interactive)
47	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
48	        curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://setup.atuin.sh | sh -s -- --non-interactive
49	      args:
50	        executable: /bin/bash
51	      failed_when: false
52	      register: atuin_install_result
53	      environment:
54	        # Suppress the installer's interactive prompts for sync registration
55	        # and shell-init injection. We do shell init ourselves via

57	        ATUIN_NO_MODIFY_PATH: "1"
58	
59	    - name: Warn atuin installation failed

61	        - atuin_install_result.rc is defined
62	        - atuin_install_result.rc != 0
63	      ansible.builtin.debug:
64	        msg: >-
65	          atuin installation failed (likely network timeout) — skipping.
66	          stdout: {{ atuin_install_result.stdout | default('') | truncate(200) }}
67	          stderr: {{ atuin_install_result.stderr | default('') | truncate(200) }}
68	
69	# =============================================================================
70	# Verify post-install (informational)
71	# =============================================================================
72	
73	- name: Verify atuin is on PATH or in ~/.atuin/bin
74	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
75	    set -o pipefail
76	    if command -v atuin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
77	      atuin --version
78	    elif [ -x "$HOME/.atuin/bin/atuin" ]; then
79	      "$HOME/.atuin/bin/atuin" --version

83	    fi

91
```

```text
4	# When true, the final rule appended to /etc/audit/rules.d/99-finalize.rules
5	# is `-e 2`, which makes the running rule set immutable until reboot. Useful
6	# for hardened production boxes; leave false during initial tuning so you
7	# can `auditctl -d` and reload rules without rebooting.
8	auditd_immutable: false
9	
10	# When true, also drop /etc/audit/rules.d/10-execve.rules with broad
11	# execve/execveat logging for both 32- and 64-bit syscalls. Very high
12	# event volume on busy hosts — leave false unless you've sized
13	# /var/log/audit/ accordingly.
14	auditd_log_all_execve: false
15	
16	# auditd.conf knobs the role manages. Conservative defaults; tune per host.
17	auditd_max_log_file_mb: 50          # rotate at 50 MB
18	auditd_num_logs: 8                  # keep 8 rotated files (~400 MB)
19	auditd_space_left_mb: 200           # warn when /var/log/audit/ has < 200 MB free
20	auditd_space_left_action: "syslog"  # syslog | email | exec | suspend | single | halt
21	auditd_disk_full_action: "syslog"   # same vocabulary; "halt" panics the kernel
```

```text
73	      rpm -q "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$p")
74	    done
75	    if [ -z "${missing[*]:-}" ]; then
76	      echo "ALL_INSTALLED"

78	    fi
```

```text
4	# oh-my-bash and ble.sh are managed declaratively via chezmoi externals at

8	# rather than here.

10	# This role's responsibilities:

12	#      hard-requires GNU awk (not BSD awk on macOS, not mawk on minimal
13	#      Ubuntu containers). Without gawk the runtime artefact at
14	#      ~/.local/share/blesh/ble.sh never gets built, so bash falls back
15	#      to plain readline + starship. Tiny package (~50KB), worth shipping
16	#      everywhere so ad-hoc bash on zsh-primary hosts also gets the full
17	#      ble.sh experience.

19	#      (system bash 3.2 is too old for OMB plugins and ble.sh).
20	#   3. macOS only: append the brew bash to /etc/shells so chsh accepts it.
21	#   4. chsh to bash when primary_shell == "bash" (all OSes).
22	#
23	# The bash PACKAGE itself is always present on Linux (every distro ships
24	# bash) and is also already on macOS as /bin/bash 3.2 — both adequate for
25	# ad-hoc use even on zsh-primary hosts. We only NEED bash 5.x when the
26	# user has selected bash as primary, hence the gate.
```

```text
120	  when:

122	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
123	  ansible.builtin.command:
124	    cmd: "dscl . -read /Users/{{ ansible_facts['user_id'] }} UserShell"
125	  register: current_shell_macos
126	  changed_when: false
127	  check_mode: false
128	  failed_when: false
129	
130	- name: Get current login shell (Linux)
131	  when:
132	    - (primary_shell | default('zsh')) == 'bash'
133	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] != "Darwin"
134	  ansible.builtin.command:
135	    cmd: "getent passwd {{ ansible_facts['user_id'] }}"
136	  register: current_shell_linux
137	  changed_when: false
138	  check_mode: false
139	  failed_when: false
140	
141	- name: Set current shell fact
142	  when: (primary_shell | default('zsh')) == 'bash'
143	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
144	    current_login_shell: >-
145	      {{ (current_shell_macos.stdout | default('')).split()[-1]
146	         if ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
147	         else (current_shell_linux.stdout | default('')).split(':')[-1] }}
148	
149	# `bash_login_shell_match` accepts either a system bash (`/bin/bash`,
150	# `/usr/bin/bash`) OR a Homebrew bash. We only re-chsh when the current
151	# login shell isn't ANY bash. This avoids re-applying on a host that's
152	# already on system bash but doesn't yet have brew bash installed (the
153	# /etc/shells whitelist + brew install fires above before this step).
154	- name: Change login shell to bash
155	  become: true
156	  tags: [sudo]
157	  ansible.builtin.user:
158	    name: "{{ ansible_facts['user_id'] }}"
159	    shell: "{{ bash_path.stdout }}"
160	  when:
161	    - (primary_shell | default('zsh')) == 'bash'
162	    - bash_path.rc == 0
163	    - bash_path.stdout | length > 0
164	    - not current_login_shell.endswith('/bash')
165
```

```text
28	# (unwritable without sudo). mise's user-managed prefix works without sudo on
29	# both Linux and macOS.

31	  when:
32	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Darwin", "Debian"]

35	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise"
36	  register: bitwarden_mise_user_bin
37

41	    - bitwarden_cli_check.rc != 0
42	    - bitwarden_mise_user_bin.stat.exists | default(false)
43	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
44	    bitwarden_mise_bin: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise"
45	
46	- name: Check for system mise (Bitwarden)
47	  when:
48	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Darwin", "Debian"]
49	    - bitwarden_cli_check.rc != 0
50	    - bitwarden_mise_bin is not defined
51	  ansible.builtin.command: mise --version
52	  register: bitwarden_mise_system_check
53	  changed_when: false
54	  failed_when: false
55	
56	- name: Set Bitwarden mise binary path (system install)
57	  when:
58	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Darwin", "Debian"]

62	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
63	    bitwarden_mise_bin: mise

66	  when:

74	      {{ bitwarden_cli_npm_package }}. Ensure Node.js is installed (e.g. via mise)
75	      and re-run ansible.
76

79	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Darwin", "Debian"]
80	    - bitwarden_cli_check.rc != 0

88	  retries: 3

104	  retries: 3

149	  changed_when: false

151

153	  when:
154	    - bitwarden_install_desktop | bool
155	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
156	    - bitwarden_desktop_linux_check.rc != 0
157	    - bitwarden_snap_check.rc == 0
158	  become: true
159	  tags: [sudo]
160	  community.general.snap:
161	    name: bitwarden
162	    state: present
163	
164	- name: Install Bitwarden Desktop via .deb fallback (Linux)
165	  when:
166	    - bitwarden_install_desktop | bool
167	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
168	    - bitwarden_desktop_linux_check.rc != 0
169	    - bitwarden_snap_check.rc != 0
170	  become: true
171	  tags: [sudo]

176	        dest: /tmp/bitwarden-desktop.deb
177	        mode: '0644'
178	        timeout: 120
179	      retries: 3

181

185

201	      3. Import your SSH keys into the vault
```

```text
288	- name: Install Gemini CLI via mise npm (Linux, user-level no-sudo)
289	  when:
290	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
291	    - gemini_check.rc != 0
292	    - not (oldEL | default(false))   # EL7: mise has no node; system node 16 < required 20
293	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
294	    if [ -x "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise" ]; then
295	      {{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise exec -- npm install -g @google/gemini-cli
296	    elif command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then
297	      mise exec -- npm install -g @google/gemini-cli
298	    else
299	      echo "mise not found, skipping Gemini CLI install" >&2
300	      exit 0
301	    fi
302	  args:
303	    executable: /bin/bash
304	  changed_when: true
305	  ignore_errors: true

307	# === Antigravity CLI ===
308	# Google's agentic terminal CLI (replaces Gemini CLI for consumer tiers, GA 2026-05-19).
309	# Cross-platform installer self-detects darwin/linux + arch + musl; binary lands at
310	# ~/.local/bin/agy.
311	#
312	# Two gotchas, both handled below:
313	#   1. NAME COLLISION — the Antigravity *IDE* also ships an `agy` (a VS Code-fork editor
314	#      launcher, no agent). To give the AICAP stack an unambiguous handle we create a
315	#      collision-free `agyc` symlink and key autodetect on that (see
316	#      dot_config/shell/04_ai_agents.sh). `agyc -p "<prompt>"` is the one-shot form.
317	#   2. SHELL MUTATION — the upstream installer's final `agy install` step APPENDS to PATH
318	#      and PURGES aliases in shell profiles. PATH is chezmoi-managed and ~/.local/bin is
319	#      already on PATH, so we rewrite that handoff to run with --skip-path --skip-aliases
320	#      (binary-only install, no profile writes). Install-only per repo invariant.
321	
322	- name: Check if Antigravity CLI is installed
323	  ansible.builtin.stat:
324	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/agy"
325	  register: agy_bin
326	  changed_when: false
327	
328	- name: Install Antigravity CLI binary (skip installer shell-profile mutation)
329	  when: not agy_bin.stat.exists
330	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
331	    set -euo pipefail
332	    tmp="$(mktemp)"
333	    curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh -o "$tmp"
334	    # Neutralize the `agy install` handoff (it edits shell profiles): rewrite both
335	    # invocations to pass --skip-path --skip-aliases so no profile is touched.
336	    sed -i.bak 's#"$BINARY_PATH" install#"$BINARY_PATH" install --skip-path --skip-aliases#g' "$tmp"
337	    bash "$tmp"
338	    rm -f "$tmp" "$tmp.bak"
339	  args:
340	    executable: /bin/bash
341	    creates: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/agy"
342	  environment:
343	    PATH: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['PATH'] }}"
344	  failed_when: false
345	  register: agy_install_result
346	
347	- name: Re-check Antigravity CLI binary after install
348	  ansible.builtin.stat:
349	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/agy"
350	  register: agy_bin_post
351	  changed_when: false
352	
353	- name: Ensure collision-free agyc symlink for the Antigravity CLI
354	  when: agy_bin_post.stat.exists
355	  ansible.builtin.file:
356	    src: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/agy"
357	    dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/agyc"
358	    state: link
359	    force: true
360	  failed_when: false
361

470	    return_content: true
471	  register: specstory_macos_release

474	  when:
475	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
476	    - specstory_macos_check.rc != 0
477	    - specstory_macos_recheck.rc != 0
478	    - specstory_macos_release is defined
479	  ansible.builtin.file:
480	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"

484	- name: Install SpecStory from GitHub release (macOS fallback)
485	  when:
486	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
487	    - specstory_macos_check.rc != 0
488	    - specstory_macos_recheck.rc != 0
489	    - specstory_macos_release is defined
490	  block:
491	    - name: Download SpecStory from GitHub release (macOS fallback)
492	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
493	        url: "https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/releases/download/{{ specstory_macos_release.json.tag_name }}/SpecStoryCLI_Darwin_{{ specstory_macos_arch }}.zip"
494	        dest: /tmp/specstory-macos.zip
495	        mode: "0644"
496	        timeout: 120
497	      retries: 3
498	      delay: 5
499	
500	    - name: Extract SpecStory to ~/.local/bin (macOS fallback)
501	      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
502	        src: /tmp/specstory-macos.zip
503	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
504	        remote_src: true
505	        mode: "0755"
506	
507	    - name: Clean up SpecStory zip (macOS fallback)
508	      ansible.builtin.file:
509	        path: /tmp/specstory-macos.zip

511	
512	  rescue:
513	    - name: Warn SpecStory installation failed (macOS fallback)
514	      ansible.builtin.debug:
515	        msg: "SpecStory installation failed (likely network timeout) - skipping"
516	
517	    - name: Clean up SpecStory temp files after failure (macOS fallback)
518	      ansible.builtin.file:
519	        path: /tmp/specstory-macos.zip
520	        state: absent
521	
522	- name: Check if SpecStory is installed (Linux)
523	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
524	  ansible.builtin.command: which specstory
525	  register: specstory_check
526	  changed_when: false
527	  failed_when: false
528	
529	- name: Get latest SpecStory release version (Linux)
530	  when:
531	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
532	    - specstory_check.rc != 0
533	  ansible.builtin.uri:
534	    url: https://api.github.com/repos/specstoryai/getspecstory/releases/latest
535	    return_content: true
536	  register: specstory_release
537	
538	- name: Set SpecStory architecture (Linux)
539	  when:
540	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
541	    - specstory_check.rc != 0
542	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
543	    specstory_linux_arch: >-
544	      {{
545	        'x86_64' if target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
546	        else 'arm64' if target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']

575	      ansible.builtin.file:
576	        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
577	        state: directory
578	        mode: "0755"
579	
580	    - name: Extract SpecStory to ~/.local/bin (Linux)
581	      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
582	        src: /tmp/specstory-linux.tar.gz
583	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
584	        remote_src: true
585	        mode: "0755"
586	
587	    - name: Clean up SpecStory tarball (Linux)
588	      ansible.builtin.file:
589	        path: /tmp/specstory-linux.tar.gz
590	        state: absent
591	
592	  rescue:
593	    - name: Warn SpecStory installation failed (Linux)
594	      ansible.builtin.debug:
595	        msg: "SpecStory installation failed (likely network timeout) - skipping"
596	
597	    - name: Clean up SpecStory temp files after failure (Linux)
598	      ansible.builtin.file:
599	        path: /tmp/specstory-linux.tar.gz
600	        state: absent

602	# === CodexBar ===
603	
604	- name: Check if CodexBar is installed (macOS, ARM only)
605	  when:
606	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
607	    - target_architecture == "arm64"
608	  ansible.builtin.command: which codexbar
609	  register: codexbar_macos_check
610	  changed_when: false
611	  failed_when: false
612	
613	- name: Tap steipete/tap for CodexBar (macOS, ARM only)
614	  when:
615	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
616	    - target_architecture == "arm64"
617	    - codexbar_macos_check.rc != 0
618	  community.general.homebrew_tap:
619	    name: steipete/tap
620	    state: present
621	
622	- name: Install CodexBar (macOS, ARM only)
623	  when:
624	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
625	    - target_architecture == "arm64"
626	    - codexbar_macos_check.rc != 0
627	  community.general.homebrew_cask:
628	    name: codexbar
629	    state: present
630	
631	- name: Check if CodexBar is installed (Linux)
632	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
633	  ansible.builtin.command: which codexbar
634	  register: codexbar_check
635	  changed_when: false
636	  failed_when: false
637	
638	- name: Check if Homebrew (Linuxbrew) is available
639	  when:
640	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
641	    - codexbar_check.rc != 0
642	  ansible.builtin.command: command -v brew
643	  register: codexbar_brew_check
644	  changed_when: false
645	  failed_when: false
646	
647	- name: Install CodexBar via Linuxbrew (preferred)
648	  when:
649	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
650	    - codexbar_check.rc != 0
651	    - codexbar_brew_check.rc == 0
652	  block:
653	    - name: Tap steipete/tap for CodexBar (Linuxbrew)
654	      community.general.homebrew_tap:
655	        name: steipete/tap
656	        state: present
657	
658	    - name: Install CodexBar (Linuxbrew)
659	      community.general.homebrew:
660	        name: codexbar
661	        state: present
662	  rescue:
663	    - name: Mark Linuxbrew install as failed
664	      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
665	        codexbar_brew_failed: true
666	
667	- name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (CodexBar fallback)
668	  when:
669	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
670	    - codexbar_check.rc != 0
671	    - codexbar_brew_check.rc != 0 or (codexbar_brew_failed | default(false))
672	  ansible.builtin.file:
673	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
674	    state: directory
675	    mode: '0755'
676	
677	- name: Get latest CodexBar release (Linux fallback)
678	  when:
679	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
680	    - codexbar_check.rc != 0
681	    - codexbar_brew_check.rc != 0 or (codexbar_brew_failed | default(false))
682	  ansible.builtin.uri:
683	    url: https://api.github.com/repos/steipete/CodexBar/releases/latest
684	    return_content: true
685	  register: codexbar_release
686	
687	- name: Compute CodexBar arch and tag (Linux fallback)
688	  when:
689	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
690	    - codexbar_check.rc != 0
691	    - codexbar_brew_check.rc != 0 or (codexbar_brew_failed | default(false))
692	    - codexbar_release is defined
693	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64', 'aarch64', 'arm64']
694	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
695	    codexbar_arch: "{{ target_architecture }}"
696	    codexbar_tag: "{{ codexbar_release.json.tag_name.startswith('v') | ternary(codexbar_release.json.tag_name, 'v' ~ codexbar_release.json.tag_name) }}"
697	
698	- name: Compute CodexBar release asset name (Linux fallback)
699	  when:
700	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
701	    - codexbar_check.rc != 0
702	    - codexbar_brew_check.rc != 0 or (codexbar_brew_failed | default(false))
703	    - codexbar_tag is defined
704	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
705	    codexbar_asset: "CodexBarCLI-{{ codexbar_tag }}-linux-{{ codexbar_arch }}.tar.gz"
706	
707	- name: Install CodexBar from GitHub releases (Linux fallback)
708	  when:
709	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
710	    - codexbar_check.rc != 0
711	    - codexbar_brew_check.rc != 0 or (codexbar_brew_failed | default(false))
712	    - codexbar_asset is defined
713	  block:
714	    - name: Download CodexBar release (Linux fallback)
715	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
716	        url: "https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/releases/download/{{ codexbar_tag }}/{{ codexbar_asset }}"
717	        dest: /tmp/codexbar.tar.gz
718	        mode: '0644'
719	        timeout: 120
720	      retries: 3
721	      delay: 5
722	
723	    - name: Create temp directory for CodexBar extraction (Linux fallback)
724	      ansible.builtin.file:
725	        path: /tmp/codexbar
726	        state: directory
727	        mode: '0755'
728	
729	    - name: Extract CodexBar release (Linux fallback)
730	      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
731	        src: /tmp/codexbar.tar.gz
732	        dest: /tmp/codexbar
733	        remote_src: true
734	
735	    - name: Find codexbar binary (Linux fallback)
736	      ansible.builtin.find:
737	        paths: /tmp/codexbar
738	        patterns: CodexBarCLI
739	        file_type: file
740	      register: codexbar_find
741	
742	    - name: Install CodexBar to ~/.local/bin (Linux fallback)
743	      when: codexbar_find.matched | default(0) | int > 0
744	      ansible.builtin.copy:
745	        src: "{{ codexbar_find.files[0].path }}"
746	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/codexbar"
747	        mode: '0755'
748	        remote_src: true
749	
750	    - name: Clean up CodexBar temp files (Linux fallback)
751	      ansible.builtin.file:
752	        path: "{{ item }}"
753	        state: absent
754	      loop:
755	        - /tmp/codexbar.tar.gz
756	        - /tmp/codexbar
757	
758	  rescue:
759	    - name: Warn CodexBar installation failed
760	      ansible.builtin.debug:
761	        msg: "CodexBar installation failed (likely network timeout) - skipping"
762	
763	    - name: Clean up CodexBar temp files after failure
764	      ansible.builtin.file:
765	        path: "{{ item }}"
766	        state: absent
767	      loop:
768	        - /tmp/codexbar.tar.gz
769	        - /tmp/codexbar

771	# === td ===
772	
773	- name: Check if td is installed (macOS)
774	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
775	  ansible.builtin.command: which td
776	  register: td_macos_check

781	  when:
782	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
783	    - td_macos_check.rc == 0
784	  ansible.builtin.shell: td --help 2>&1 | grep -Eq '\bsession\b'
785	  register: td_macos_compatible_check
786	  changed_when: false
787	  failed_when: false
788	
789	- name: Remove conflicting td formula (macOS)
790	  when:
791	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
792	    - td_macos_check.rc == 0
793	    - td_macos_compatible_check.rc != 0
794	  community.general.homebrew:
795	    name: td
796	    state: absent
797	
798	- name: Tap marcus/tap for td (macOS)
799	  when:
800	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
801	    - td_macos_check.rc != 0 or (td_macos_compatible_check.rc is defined and td_macos_compatible_check.rc != 0)
802	  community.general.homebrew_tap:
803	    name: marcus/tap
804	    state: present
805	
806	- name: Install td (macOS)
807	  when:
808	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
809	    - td_macos_check.rc != 0 or (td_macos_compatible_check.rc is defined and td_macos_compatible_check.rc != 0)
810	  community.general.homebrew:
811	    name: marcus/tap/td
812	    state: present
813	
814	- name: Check if td is installed (Linux)
815	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
816	  ansible.builtin.command: which td
817	  register: td_check
818	  changed_when: false
819	  failed_when: false
820	
821	- name: Check whether installed td is Sidecar-compatible (Linux)
822	  when:
823	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
824	    - td_check.rc == 0
825	  ansible.builtin.shell: td --help 2>&1 | grep -Eq '\bsession\b'
826	  register: td_compatible_check
827	  changed_when: false
828	  failed_when: false
829	
830	- name: Check if Homebrew (Linuxbrew) is available for td
831	  when:
832	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
833	    - td_check.rc != 0 or (td_compatible_check.rc is defined and td_compatible_check.rc != 0)
834	  ansible.builtin.command: command -v brew
835	  register: td_brew_check
836	  changed_when: false
837	  failed_when: false
838	
839	- name: Remove conflicting td formula (Linuxbrew)
840	  when:
841	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]

1231	# Install-only by design: the helper exits early without any network access when
1232	# a claude-hud cache or installed_plugins.json entry already exists. Explicit
1233	# upgrades are handled by `just upgrade-plugins`.
1234	#
1235	# Why `ansible_facts.python.executable` instead of literal `python3`?
1236	# claude_hud_sync.py uses `from __future__ import annotations` (Py3.7+
1237	# syntax) plus `@dataclass`. CentOS 7's `/usr/bin/python3` is 3.6.8 which
1238	# can't parse `from __future__ import annotations` and aborts with
1239	# `SyntaxError: future feature annotations is not defined`.
1240	# `ansible_facts.python.executable` is the interpreter ansible itself
1241	# discovered/was-told-to-use (which on CentOS 7 is the uv-managed 3.13
1242	# we override via the controlling chezmoi script — see
1243	# .chezmoiscripts/global/run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl).
1244	- name: Install claude-hud plugin on first apply only
1245	  ansible.builtin.command:
1246	    argv:
1247	      - "{{ ansible_facts.python.executable | default('python3') }}"
1248	      - "{{ role_path }}/files/claude_hud_sync.py"
1249	      - --only-if-missing
1250	  register: claude_hud_sync
1251	  changed_when: "'status=changed' in claude_hud_sync.stdout"
```

```text
396	    src: /usr/bin/batcat

438	    - name: Get latest bat release
439	      ansible.builtin.uri:

441	        return_content: true
442	      register: bat_release
443	
444	    - name: Download bat binary

447	        dest: /tmp/bat.tar.gz

487	- name: Install bats (Debian/Ubuntu)

495	# --- bats (user-level fallback) ---
496	# Gate broadened to RedHat per pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md — the user-level
497	# install (curl GitHub release tarball, run install.sh) has no apt-specific
498	# behaviour and works on any glibc-2.17+ system.
499	- name: Re-check if bats is installed
500	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]

511	    - bats_recheck.rc != 0
512	  block:
513	    - name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (bats)
514	      ansible.builtin.file:
515	        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
516	        state: directory

520	      ansible.builtin.uri:
521	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/bats-core/bats-core/releases/latest
522	        return_content: true
523	      register: bats_release
524	
525	    - name: Download bats-core tarball
526	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
527	        url: "https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core/archive/refs/tags/{{ bats_release.json.tag_name }}.tar.gz"
528	        dest: /tmp/bats.tar.gz
529	        mode: '0644'
530	        timeout: 120
531	      retries: 3
532	      delay: 5
533	
534	    - name: Extract and install bats-core to ~/.local
535	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
536	        set -euo pipefail
537	        rm -rf /tmp/bats-extract
538	        mkdir -p /tmp/bats-extract
539	        tar -xzf /tmp/bats.tar.gz -C /tmp/bats-extract --strip-components=1
540	        /tmp/bats-extract/install.sh "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local"
541	      args:
542	        executable: /bin/bash

547	        path: "{{ item }}"

564	        - /tmp/bats-extract

566	# --- zoxide ---
567	- name: Check if zoxide is installed

570	  register: zoxide_check
571	  changed_when: false
572	  failed_when: false
573	
574	- name: Install zoxide via official installer (Debian/Ubuntu)
575	  when:
576	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
577	    - zoxide_check.rc != 0
578	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
579	    curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ajeetdsouza/zoxide/main/install.sh | sh
580	  args:
581	    creates: "{{ ansible_facts.env.HOME }}/.local/bin/zoxide"
582	  failed_when: false
583	  register: zoxide_install_result
584

586	  when:
587	    - zoxide_install_result is defined
588	    - zoxide_install_result.rc is defined

593	# --- eza ---
594	- name: Check if eza is installed
595	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
596	  ansible.builtin.command: eza --version
597	  register: eza_check
598	  changed_when: false
599	  failed_when: false
600	
601	- name: Install eza via official installer (Debian/Ubuntu)
602	  when:
603	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
604	    - eza_check.rc != 0
605	  become: true
606	  tags: [sudo]
607	  block:
608	    - name: Add eza GPG key
609	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
610	        mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
611	        wget -qO- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eza-community/eza/main/deb.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/gierens.gpg
612	      args:
613	        creates: /etc/apt/keyrings/gierens.gpg
614	
615	    # apt_repository internally runs `apt update`, which fails on machines
616	    # with any broken third-party repo (expired GPG, missing Release file, etc.).
617	    # Tolerate that and let the GitHub-release fallback below install eza instead.
618	    - name: Add eza repository
619	      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
620	        repo: "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/gierens.gpg] http://deb.gierens.de stable main"
621	        state: present
622	        filename: gierens
623	      ignore_errors: true
624	      register: eza_repo
625	
626	    - name: Install eza from repository
627	      ansible.builtin.apt:
628	        name: eza
629	        state: present
630	        update_cache: true
631	      when: eza_repo is succeeded
632	      ignore_errors: true
633	  rescue:
634	    - name: Warn eza apt install failed
635	      ansible.builtin.debug:
636	        msg: "eza apt install failed (likely broken third-party repo) — will try GitHub fallback"
637	
638	# --- eza (user-level fallback) ---
639	# Upstream publishes a musl tarball for x86_64 only. aarch64 has just
640	# `unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`, which can break on Jammy when upstream CI uses a
641	# newer glibc. Split the user fallback by arch:
642	#   - x86_64: switch to `eza_x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz`.
643	#   - aarch64: probe Linuxbrew; install via brew if present, otherwise skip
644	#     with an explicit warning.
645	- name: Re-check if eza is installed
646	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
647	  ansible.builtin.shell: command -v eza
648	  register: eza_recheck
649	  changed_when: false
650	  failed_when: false
651	
652	- name: Install eza musl from GitHub releases (user-level, x86_64)
653	  when:
654	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
655	    - eza_recheck.rc != 0
656	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
657	  block:
658	    - name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (eza)
659	      ansible.builtin.file:
660	        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
661	        state: directory
662	        mode: '0755'
663	
664	    - name: Get latest eza release
665	      ansible.builtin.uri:
666	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/eza-community/eza/releases/latest
667	        return_content: true
668	      register: eza_release
669	
670	    - name: Download eza musl binary (x86_64)
671	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
672	        url: "https://github.com/eza-community/eza/releases/download/{{ eza_release.json.tag_name }}/eza_x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz"
673	        dest: /tmp/eza.tar.gz
674	        mode: '0644'
675	        timeout: 120
676	      retries: 3
677	      delay: 5
678	
679	    - name: Extract eza to ~/.local/bin
680	      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
681	        src: /tmp/eza.tar.gz
682	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
683	        remote_src: true
684	
685	    - name: Clean up eza tarball
686	      ansible.builtin.file:
687	        path: /tmp/eza.tar.gz
688	        state: absent
689	
690	  rescue:
691	    - name: Warn eza installation failed
692	      ansible.builtin.debug:
693	        msg: "eza installation failed (likely network timeout) - skipping"
694	
695	    - name: Clean up eza temp files after failure
696	      ansible.builtin.file:
697	        path: "{{ item }}"
698	        state: absent
699	      loop:
700	        - /tmp/eza.tar.gz
701	
702	# --- eza (aarch64 user fallback: brew or skip — no upstream musl asset) ---
703	- name: Detect Linuxbrew for eza user fallback (Debian/Ubuntu, aarch64)
704	  when:
705	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
706	    - eza_recheck.rc != 0
707	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
708	  ansible.builtin.shell: command -v brew || true
709	  args:
710	    executable: /bin/bash
711	  register: eza_brew_probe
712	  changed_when: false
713	
714	- name: Install eza via Linuxbrew (user fallback, aarch64, brew available)
715	  when:
716	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
717	    - eza_recheck.rc != 0
718	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
719	    - eza_brew_probe is defined
720	    - eza_brew_probe.stdout | default('') | trim != ''
721	  community.general.homebrew:
722	    name: eza
723	    state: present
724	
725	- name: Warn eza cannot be installed safely (aarch64, no brew)
726	  when:
727	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
728	    - eza_recheck.rc != 0
729	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
730	    - (eza_brew_probe is not defined) or (eza_brew_probe.stdout | default('') | trim == '')
731	  ansible.builtin.debug:
732	    msg: >-
733	      eza skipped on aarch64: upstream publishes only `unknown-linux-gnu`
734	      tarball for aarch64 which may require a newer glibc than Jammy (2.35).
735	      Install Linuxbrew (`brew install eza`) or wait for an upstream musl
736	      arm64 build.

738	# --- git-delta ---
739	# Delta can start successfully but crash when reading stdin if bat's binary
740	# theme cache was built by an incompatible bat version. Verify by actually
741	# feeding delta an empty diff, not only by checking `--version`.
742	# Glibc landscape:
743	#   - x86_64: upstream publishes `unknown-linux-musl` (static, glibc-independent).
744	#     User-level fallback now uses it (was `unknown-linux-gnu` until the
745	#     centos7-noroot.md sweep). Works on glibc 2.17.
746	#   - aarch64: only `unknown-linux-gnu` assets exist, and delta 0.19.x briefly
747	#     required glibc 2.39 (unavailable on Jammy). We therefore:
748	#       1) sudo path (apt .deb) is Debian/Ubuntu-only.
749	#       2) aarch64 falls through to Linuxbrew (`brew install git-delta`) or
750	#          skips with a clear debug message rather than silently pulling a
751	#          glibc-risky binary.
752	- name: Check if delta is installed
753	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
754	  ansible.builtin.shell: printf '' | delta --no-gitconfig --paging=never
755	  args:
756	    executable: /bin/bash
757	  register: delta_check
758	  changed_when: false
759	  failed_when: false
760	
761	- name: Skip git-delta on unsupported architecture
762	  when:
763	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
764	    - delta_check.rc != 0
765	    - target_architecture not in ['x86_64', 'amd64', 'aarch64', 'arm64']
766	  ansible.builtin.debug:
767	    msg: "git-delta skipped: no release for {{ target_architecture }}"
768	
769	- name: Install git-delta .deb (Debian/Ubuntu, x86_64)
770	  when:
771	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
772	    - delta_check.rc != 0
773	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
774	  become: true
775	  tags: [sudo]
776	  block:
777	    - name: Get latest delta release
778	      ansible.builtin.uri:
779	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/dandavison/delta/releases/latest
780	        return_content: true
781	      register: delta_release
782	
783	    - name: Download git-delta .deb package
784	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
785	        url: "https://github.com/dandavison/delta/releases/download/{{ delta_release.json.tag_name }}/git-delta_{{ delta_release.json.tag_name }}_amd64.deb"
786	        dest: /tmp/git-delta.deb
787	        mode: '0644'
788	        timeout: 120
789	      retries: 3
790	      delay: 5
791	
792	    - name: Install delta .deb package
793	      ansible.builtin.apt:
794	        deb: /tmp/git-delta.deb
795	
796	    - name: Clean up delta .deb
797	      ansible.builtin.file:
798	        path: /tmp/git-delta.deb
799	        state: absent
800	
801	  rescue:
802	    - name: Warn git-delta installation failed
803	      ansible.builtin.debug:
804	        msg: "git-delta installation failed (likely network timeout) - skipping"
805	
806	    - name: Clean up git-delta temp files after failure
807	      ansible.builtin.file:
808	        path: /tmp/git-delta.deb
809	        state: absent
810	
811	# --- git-delta (aarch64: brew or skip — no upstream musl asset) ---
812	- name: Detect Linuxbrew for git-delta (Debian/Ubuntu, aarch64)
813	  when:
814	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
815	    - delta_check.rc != 0
816	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
817	  ansible.builtin.shell: command -v brew || true
818	  args:
819	    executable: /bin/bash
820	  register: delta_brew_probe
821	  changed_when: false
822	
823	- name: Install git-delta via Linuxbrew (Debian/Ubuntu, aarch64, brew available)
824	  when:
825	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
826	    - delta_check.rc != 0
827	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
828	    - delta_brew_probe is defined
829	    - delta_brew_probe.stdout | default('') | trim != ''
830	  community.general.homebrew:
831	    name: git-delta
832	    state: present
833	
834	- name: Warn git-delta cannot be installed safely (aarch64, no brew)
835	  when:
836	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
837	    - delta_check.rc != 0
838	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
839	    - (delta_brew_probe is not defined) or (delta_brew_probe.stdout | default('') | trim == '')
840	  ansible.builtin.debug:
841	    msg: >-
842	      git-delta skipped on aarch64: upstream publishes only `unknown-linux-gnu`
843	      assets, which historically require glibc >= 2.39 and may fail on Jammy
844	      (glibc 2.35). Install Linuxbrew (`brew install git-delta`) or wait for
845	      an upstream musl arm64 build.
846	
847	# --- git-delta (user-level fallback) ---
848	# Gate broadened to RedHat per pitfalls/centos7-noroot.md — x86_64 uses the
849	# upstream `unknown-linux-musl` tarball (glibc-independent). aarch64 still
850	# has no upstream musl; that path stays Debian-only (Linuxbrew aarch64 on
851	# CentOS 7 is not a typical setup we support).
852	- name: Re-check if delta is installed
853	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
854	  ansible.builtin.shell: command -v delta && printf '' | delta --no-gitconfig --paging=never
855	  args:
856	    executable: /bin/bash
857	  register: delta_recheck
858	  changed_when: false
859	  failed_when: false
860	
861	- name: Install git-delta tarball (user-level, no sudo, x86_64)
862	  when:
863	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
864	    - delta_recheck.rc != 0
865	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
866	  block:
867	    - name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (delta)
868	      ansible.builtin.file:
869	        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
870	        state: directory
871	        mode: '0755'
872	
873	    - name: Get latest delta release (user)
874	      ansible.builtin.uri:
875	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/dandavison/delta/releases/latest
876	        return_content: true
877	      register: delta_release_user
878	
879	    - name: Download delta musl tarball (user)
880	      # Switched from `-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` to the musl variant
881	      # so CentOS 7 (glibc 2.17) can install it without source build. The
882	      # gnu tarball historically required glibc 2.39 on aarch64 too.
883	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
884	        url: "https://github.com/dandavison/delta/releases/download/{{ delta_release_user.json.tag_name }}/delta-{{ delta_release_user.json.tag_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz"
885	        dest: /tmp/delta.tar.gz
886	        mode: '0644'
887	        timeout: 120
888	      retries: 3
889	      delay: 5
890	
891	    - name: Extract delta (user)
892	      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
893	        src: /tmp/delta.tar.gz
894	        dest: /tmp
895	        remote_src: true
896	
897	    - name: Install delta to ~/.local/bin
898	      ansible.builtin.copy:
899	        src: "/tmp/delta-{{ delta_release_user.json.tag_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/delta"
900	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/delta"
901	        mode: '0755'
902	        remote_src: true
903	
904	    - name: Clean up delta temp files (user)
905	      ansible.builtin.file:
906	        path: "{{ item }}"
907	        state: absent
908	      loop:
909	        - /tmp/delta.tar.gz
910	        - "/tmp/delta-{{ delta_release_user.json.tag_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl"
911	
912	  rescue:
913	    - name: Warn git-delta (user) installation failed
914	      ansible.builtin.debug:
915	        msg: "git-delta (user) installation failed (likely network timeout) - skipping"
916	
917	    - name: Clean up git-delta (user) temp files after failure
918	      ansible.builtin.file:
919	        path: "{{ item }}"
920	        state: absent
921	      loop:
922	        - /tmp/delta.tar.gz
923	
924	# --- git-delta (aarch64 user fallback: brew or skip) ---
925	- name: Detect Linuxbrew for git-delta user fallback (Debian/Ubuntu, aarch64)
926	  when:
927	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
928	    - delta_recheck.rc != 0
929	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
930	  ansible.builtin.shell: command -v brew || true
931	  args:
932	    executable: /bin/bash
933	  register: delta_brew_probe_user
934	  changed_when: false
935	
936	- name: Install git-delta via Linuxbrew (user fallback, aarch64, brew available)
937	  when:
938	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
939	    - delta_recheck.rc != 0
940	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
941	    - delta_brew_probe_user is defined
942	    - delta_brew_probe_user.stdout | default('') | trim != ''
943	  community.general.homebrew:
944	    name: git-delta
945	    state: present
946	
947	- name: Warn git-delta (user) cannot be installed safely (aarch64, no brew)
948	  when:
949	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
950	    - delta_recheck.rc != 0
951	    - target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
952	    - (delta_brew_probe_user is not defined) or (delta_brew_probe_user.stdout | default('') | trim == '')
953	  ansible.builtin.debug:
954	    msg: >-
955	      git-delta (user) skipped on aarch64: no upstream musl asset. Install
956	      Linuxbrew for a safe `brew install git-delta`, or wait for an upstream
957	      musl arm64 build.

959	# --- diffnav ---
960	- name: Check if diffnav is installed
961	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"

963	  register: diffnav_check
964	  changed_when: false
965	  failed_when: false
966	  environment:
967	    PATH: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['PATH'] }}"
968	
969	- name: Set diffnav release architecture
970	  # Broadened to RedHat + decoupled from diffnav_check so the user-level
971	  # fallback works on CentOS 7 where the sudo .deb install is skipped.
972	  when:
973	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
974	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
975	    diffnav_release_arch: >-
976	      {{
977	        'x86_64' if target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
978	        else 'arm64' if target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
979	        else ''
980	      }}

983	  when:
984	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"

986	    - diffnav_release_arch == ''

988	    msg: "diffnav skipped: no release for {{ target_architecture }}"

990	- name: Install diffnav from GitHub releases (Debian/Ubuntu)
991	  when:
992	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
993	    - diffnav_check.rc != 0
994	    - diffnav_release_arch != ''
995	  become: true
996	  tags: [sudo]
997	  block:
998	    - name: Get latest diffnav release
999	      ansible.builtin.uri:
1000	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/dlvhdr/diffnav/releases/latest
1001	        return_content: true
1002	      register: diffnav_release
1003	
1004	    - name: Download diffnav tarball

1007	        dest: /tmp/diffnav.tar.gz
1008	        mode: '0644'
1009	        timeout: 120
1010	      retries: 3
1011	      delay: 5
1012	
1013	    - name: Extract and install diffnav
1014	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
1015	        set -euo pipefail
1016	        rm -rf /tmp/diffnav-extract
1017	        mkdir -p /tmp/diffnav-extract
1018	        tar -xzf /tmp/diffnav.tar.gz -C /tmp/diffnav-extract
1019	        diffnav_bin="$(find /tmp/diffnav-extract -type f -name diffnav | head -n 1)"
1020	        install -m 0755 "$diffnav_bin" /usr/local/bin/diffnav
1021	      args:
1022	        executable: /bin/bash
1023	      changed_when: true
1024	
1025	    - name: Clean up diffnav temp files
1026	      ansible.builtin.file:
1027	        path: "{{ item }}"
1028	        state: absent
1029	      loop:
1030	        - /tmp/diffnav.tar.gz
1031	        - /tmp/diffnav-extract
1032	
1033	  rescue:
1034	    - name: Warn diffnav installation failed
1035	      ansible.builtin.debug:
1036	        msg: "diffnav installation failed (likely network timeout) - skipping"
1037	
1038	    - name: Clean up diffnav temp files after failure
1039	      ansible.builtin.file:
1040	        path: "{{ item }}"
1041	        state: absent
1042	      loop:
1043	        - /tmp/diffnav.tar.gz
1044	        - /tmp/diffnav-extract
```

```text
17	  - name: azure-cost-cli
```

```text
1	---
2	# .NET global tools installation
3	# .NET SDK is installed via mise (`mise use -g dotnet@<version>`), which puts
4	# a dotnet shim under ~/.local/share/mise/shims/dotnet and lets `dotnet tool
5	# install --global` drop binaries into ~/.dotnet/tools (hardcoded by dotnet).
6	# ~/.dotnet/tools is prepended to PATH by dot_config/zsh/00_exports.zsh when it
7	# exists.
8	
9	# =============================================================================
10	# Ensure dotnet SDK is installed via mise
11	# =============================================================================
12	
13	- name: Check for user-installed mise (dotnet_tools)
14	  ansible.builtin.stat:
15	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise"
16	  register: dotnet_mise_user_install
17	
18	- name: Set mise binary path (dotnet_tools)
19	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
20	    dotnet_mise_bin: >-
21	      {{
22	        (ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] + '/.local/bin/mise')
23	        if dotnet_mise_user_install.stat.exists
24	        else ('/opt/homebrew/bin/mise' if ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Darwin' else '/usr/local/bin/mise')
25	      }}
26	
27	- name: Verify mise binary is reachable (dotnet_tools)
28	  ansible.builtin.stat:
29	    path: "{{ dotnet_mise_bin }}"
30	  register: dotnet_mise_bin_stat
31	
32	- name: Skip dotnet_tools when mise is unavailable
33	  when: not dotnet_mise_bin_stat.stat.exists
34	  ansible.builtin.debug:
35	    msg: >-
36	      dotnet_tools: mise not found at {{ dotnet_mise_bin }} — skipping install
37	      of {{ dotnet_tools | map(attribute='name') | list | join(', ') }}.
38	      Install mise first (bootstrap script / curl https://mise.run | sh) and
39	      re-run `chezmoi apply` or `ansible-playbook ... --tags dotnet_tools`.
40	
41	- name: Install and pin dotnet via mise
42	  when: dotnet_mise_bin_stat.stat.exists
43	  ansible.builtin.command: "{{ dotnet_mise_bin }} use -g dotnet@{{ dotnet_version }}"
44	  args:
45	    creates: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/mise/installs/dotnet"
46	  register: dotnet_mise_use
47	  environment:
48	    PATH: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['PATH'] }}"
49	
50	# =============================================================================
51	# Install .NET global tools (loop over dotnet_tools)
52	# =============================================================================
53	
54	# `dotnet tool install --global` is NOT idempotent (exits 1 when already
55	# installed), so we probe each binary first and skip when present. To catch
56	# upstream updates, users can re-run with the explicit `update` command:
57	#   dotnet tool update --global <name>
58	
59	- name: Check whether each dotnet_tool binary is present
60	  when:
61	    - dotnet_mise_bin_stat.stat.exists
62	    - dotnet_tools | length > 0
63	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
64	    export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH"
65	    command -v {{ item.binary }}
66	  args:
67	    executable: /bin/bash
68	  register: dotnet_tool_presence
69	  changed_when: false
70	  failed_when: false
71	  loop: "{{ dotnet_tools }}"
72	  loop_control:
73	    label: "{{ item.binary }}"
74	
75	- name: Build list of dotnet_tools still missing
76	  when:
77	    - dotnet_mise_bin_stat.stat.exists
78	    - dotnet_tools | length > 0
79	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
80	    dotnet_tools_to_install: >-
81	      {{
82	        dotnet_tool_presence.results
83	        | selectattr('rc', 'ne', 0)
84	        | map(attribute='item')
85	        | list
86	      }}
87	
88	- name: Install missing dotnet_tools via `dotnet tool install --global`
89	  when:
90	    - dotnet_mise_bin_stat.stat.exists
91	    - dotnet_tools_to_install is defined
92	    - dotnet_tools_to_install | length > 0
93	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
94	    export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH"
95	    {{ dotnet_mise_bin }} exec dotnet@{{ dotnet_version }} -- dotnet tool install --global {{ item.name }}
96	  args:
97	    executable: /bin/bash
98	  register: dotnet_tool_install
99	  until: dotnet_tool_install is succeeded
100	  retries: 3
101	  delay: 10
102	  changed_when: >-
103	    'was successfully installed' in dotnet_tool_install.stdout
104	    or 'Installed' in dotnet_tool_install.stdout
105	  loop: "{{ dotnet_tools_to_install }}"
106	  loop_control:
107	    label: "{{ item.name }}"
108
```
