6	# repos: Alacritty (cargo), AppImageLauncher (PPA / .deb / Lite), VSCode
7	# (Microsoft apt repo), Cursor (.deb with graceful fallback), Discord (.deb,
8	# x86_64-only), Zen Browser (AppImage + .desktop), libfuse2 (AppImage runtime
9	# on Ubuntu 22.04+), and a placeholder hook for Antigravity once an official
10	# Linux package ships.
11	#
12	# No-op on:
13	#   - macOS  → Brewfile (`cask "alacritty"`, `cask "visual-studio-code"` when
14	#              you add them) covers the desktop story. This role emits a
15	#              debug note only on Darwin, no install logic runs.
16	#   - armhf  → 32-bit ARM has no practical GUI story; cargo builds are slow
17	#              and AppImages lack first-class armv7 support.
18	#   - noRoot → `--skip-tags sudo` (set by run_onchange) skips every system
19	#              apt/deb/PPA task. AppImageLauncher Lite (user-level AppImage)
20	#              still runs when `gui_apps_linux_no_root=true` is passed via
21	#              `--extra-vars`.
22	#
23	# Editor user-config overlays (settings.json / keybindings.json) are handled
24	# by chezmoi itself, NOT ansible — see `.chezmoitemplates/editor/` and the
25	# `modify_settings.json.tmpl` / `create_keybindings.json.tmpl` source files.
26	#
27	# Adding a new GUI app: read docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.md FIRST. It
28	# contains the .deb / Snap / Flatpak / AppImage decision tree, the
29	# "concrete patterns" you'd copy here, and the inventory table you must
30	# also update so the doc stays in sync with this role.
31	# =============================================================================
32	
33	# --- Platform banner ---
34	
35	- name: Announce gui_apps_linux is Linux-only (macOS uses Brewfile)
36	  when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Darwin'
37	  ansible.builtin.debug:
38	    msg: >-
39	      gui_apps_linux is Linux-only. macOS GUI apps are declared in
40	      dot_config/homebrew/Brewfile.darwin.tmpl (alacritty cask, etc.).
41	
42	- name: Skip gui_apps_linux on armhf
43	  when:
44	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
45	    - target_architecture == 'armv7l'
46	  ansible.builtin.debug:
47	    msg: >-
48	      Skipping gui_apps_linux on armhf — no practical GUI stack,
49	      cargo builds of alacritty are very slow, and upstream AppImages
50	      do not target armv7.
51	
52	# =============================================================================
53	# Alacritty (moved verbatim from the former alacritty role)
54	# =============================================================================
55	
56	- name: Install Alacritty build dependencies
57	  when:
58	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
59	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
60	  become: true
61	  tags: [sudo]
62	  ansible.builtin.apt:
63	    name:
64	      - cmake
65	      - pkg-config
66	      - libfontconfig1-dev
67	      - libxcb-xfixes0-dev
68	      - libxkbcommon-dev
69	    state: present
70	    update_cache: false
71	
72	- name: Check if Alacritty is already installed
73	  when:
74	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
75	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
76	  ansible.builtin.command: alacritty --version
77	  register: alacritty_check
78	  changed_when: false
79	  failed_when: false
80	  environment:
81	    PATH: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.cargo/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['PATH'] }}"
82	
83	- name: Install Alacritty via cargo
84	  when:
85	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
86	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
87	    - alacritty_check.rc != 0
88	  ansible.builtin.command: cargo install alacritty
89	  args:
90	    creates: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.cargo/bin/alacritty"
91	  environment:
92	    PATH: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/mise/shims:{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.cargo/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['PATH'] }}"
93	  timeout: 3600
94	
95	- name: Ensure user icon + application dirs exist
96	  when:
97	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
98	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
99	  ansible.builtin.file:
100	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/{{ item }}"
101	    state: directory
102	    mode: '0755'
103	  loop:
104	    - .local/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps
105	    - .local/share/applications
106	
107	- name: Download Alacritty SVG icon
108	  when:
109	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
110	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
111	  ansible.builtin.get_url:
112	    url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alacritty/alacritty/master/extra/logo/alacritty-term.svg
113	    dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/alacritty.svg"
114	    mode: '0644'
115	  retries: 3
116	  delay: 5
117	
118	- name: Install Alacritty .desktop entry
119	  when:
120	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
121	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
122	  ansible.builtin.copy:
123	    dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/applications/alacritty.desktop"
124	    mode: '0644'
125	    content: |
126	      [Desktop Entry]
127	      Type=Application
128	      TryExec=alacritty
129	      Exec=alacritty
130	      Icon=alacritty
131	      Terminal=false
132	      Categories=System;TerminalEmulator;
133	      Name=Alacritty
134	      GenericName=Terminal
135	      Comment=A fast, cross-platform, OpenGL terminal emulator
136	      StartupWMClass=alacritty
137	
138	- name: Refresh desktop application database
139	  when:
140	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
141	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
142	  ansible.builtin.command: update-desktop-database "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/applications"
143	  changed_when: false
144	  failed_when: false
145	
146	# =============================================================================
147	# libfuse2 — AppImage runtime on Ubuntu 22.04+
148	# Ubuntu dropped libfuse2 from the default install around 22.04; AppImages
149	# compiled against it fail with a cryptic "dlopen(): error loading libfuse.so.2"
150	# on boot. Installing the compat package fixes every AppImage we ship below.
151	# =============================================================================
152	
153	- name: Install libfuse2 for AppImage compatibility
154	  when:
155	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
156	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
157	  become: true
158	  tags: [sudo]
159	  ansible.builtin.apt:
160	    name: libfuse2
161	    state: present
162	    update_cache: false
163	  ignore_errors: true
164	
165	# =============================================================================
166	# AppImageLauncher — desktop integration for AppImages
167	#
168	# Strategy (in order):
169	#   1. PPA `ppa:appimagelauncher-team/stable` — preferred on 20.04/22.04.
170	#   2. GitHub `.deb` fallback — PPA is known-broken on Ubuntu 24.04 "noble"
171	#      as of 2026 (upstream has not published a noble release); the latest
172	#      GitHub `.deb` still installs cleanly.
173	#   3. AppImageLauncher **Lite** — a user-level AppImage that integrates
174	#      itself without root. Enabled when `gui_apps_linux_no_root=true`.
175	#
176	# Docs: see docs/tools/appimage.md for install paths, ail-cli usage, and
177	# the libfuse2 / AppArmor gotchas on recent Ubuntu.
178	# =============================================================================
179	
180	- name: Check if AppImageLauncher is installed (system-wide)
181	  when:
182	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
183	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
184	  ansible.builtin.command: dpkg -s appimagelauncher
185	  register: ail_check
186	  changed_when: false
187	  failed_when: false
188	
189	- name: Install AppImageLauncher via PPA
190	  when:
191	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
192	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
193	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
194	    - ail_check.rc != 0
195	  become: true
196	  tags: [sudo]
197	  block:
198	    - name: Add AppImageLauncher PPA
199	      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
200	        repo: ppa:appimagelauncher-team/stable
201	        state: present
202	        update_cache: true
203	        filename: appimagelauncher-team-stable
204	      ignore_errors: true
205	      register: ail_ppa
206	
207	    - name: Install appimagelauncher from PPA
208	      ansible.builtin.apt:
209	        name: appimagelauncher
210	        state: present
211	      when: ail_ppa is succeeded
212	      register: ail_apt_install
213	      ignore_errors: true
214	  rescue:
215	    - name: Warn AppImageLauncher PPA install failed
216	      ansible.builtin.debug:
217	        msg: "AppImageLauncher PPA install failed — trying GitHub .deb fallback next."
218	
219	- name: Install AppImageLauncher from GitHub .deb (fallback)
220	  when:
221	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
222	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
223	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
224	    - ail_check.rc != 0
225	    - (ail_apt_install is not defined) or (ail_apt_install is not succeeded)
226	  become: true
227	  tags: [sudo]
228	  block:
229	    - name: Get latest AppImageLauncher release metadata
230	      ansible.builtin.uri:
231	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/TheAssassin/AppImageLauncher/releases/latest
232	        return_content: true
233	      register: ail_release
234	
235	    - name: Resolve AppImageLauncher .deb asset URL
236	      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
237	        ail_deb_url: >-
238	          {{ (ail_release.json.assets
239	              | selectattr('name', 'match', '^appimagelauncher_.*_' + ail_deb_arch + '\\.deb$')
240	              | map(attribute='browser_download_url')
241	              | list
242	              | first) | default('') }}
243	      vars:
244	        ail_deb_arch: "{{ {'x86_64': 'amd64', 'aarch64': 'arm64'}[target_architecture] }}"
245	
246	    - name: Download AppImageLauncher .deb
247	      when: ail_deb_url | length > 0
248	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
249	        url: "{{ ail_deb_url }}"
250	        dest: /tmp/appimagelauncher.deb
251	        mode: '0644'
252	        timeout: 180
253	
254	    - name: Install AppImageLauncher .deb
255	      when: ail_deb_url | length > 0
256	      ansible.builtin.apt:
257	        deb: /tmp/appimagelauncher.deb
258	        state: present
259	  rescue:
260	    - name: Warn AppImageLauncher .deb install failed
261	      ansible.builtin.debug:
262	        msg: "AppImageLauncher .deb install failed — the Lite user-level variant is still available via noRoot mode."
263	
264	- name: Install AppImageLauncher Lite (user-level, noRoot)
265	  when:
266	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
267	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
268	    - gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool
269	  block:
270	    - name: Ensure ~/Applications exists
271	      ansible.builtin.file:
272	        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications"
273	        state: directory
274	        mode: '0755'
275	
276	    - name: Get latest AppImageLauncher release (for Lite variant)
277	      ansible.builtin.uri:
278	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/TheAssassin/AppImageLauncher/releases/latest
279	        return_content: true
280	      register: ail_lite_release
281	
282	    - name: Resolve AppImageLauncher Lite AppImage URL
283	      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
284	        ail_lite_url: >-
285	          {{ (ail_lite_release.json.assets
286	              | selectattr('name', 'match', '^appimagelauncher-lite-.*-' + target_architecture + '\\.AppImage$')
287	              | map(attribute='browser_download_url')
288	              | list
289	              | first) | default('') }}
290	
291	    - name: Download AppImageLauncher Lite
292	      when: ail_lite_url | length > 0
293	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
294	        url: "{{ ail_lite_url }}"
295	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/appimagelauncher-lite.AppImage"
296	        mode: '0755'
297	        timeout: 180
298	      register: ail_lite_dl
299	      ignore_errors: true
300	
301	    - name: Note how to finalise AppImageLauncher Lite integration
302	      when: ail_lite_dl is defined and ail_lite_dl is succeeded
303	      ansible.builtin.debug:
304	        msg: >-
305	          Downloaded AppImageLauncher Lite to ~/Applications/appimagelauncher-lite.AppImage.
306	          Run `~/Applications/appimagelauncher-lite.AppImage install` once to register
307	          the integration; see docs/tools/appimage.md for ail-cli usage.
308	
309	# =============================================================================
310	# Visual Studio Code — official Microsoft apt repository
311	# =============================================================================
312	
313	- name: Check if VSCode is installed
314	  when:
315	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
316	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
317	  ansible.builtin.command: dpkg -s code
318	  register: vscode_check
319	  changed_when: false
320	  failed_when: false
321	
322	- name: Install VSCode via Microsoft apt repo
323	  when:
324	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
325	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
326	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
327	    - vscode_check.rc != 0
328	  become: true
329	  tags: [sudo]
330	  block:
331	    - name: Ensure /etc/apt/keyrings exists
332	      ansible.builtin.file:
333	        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
334	        state: directory
335	        mode: '0755'
336	
337	    - name: Add Microsoft GPG key (dearmored)
338	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
339	        set -eu
340	        wget -qO- https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc \
341	          | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
342	      args:
343	        creates: /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
344	
345	    - name: Add VSCode apt repository
346	      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
347	        repo: >-
348	          deb [arch={{ {'x86_64': 'amd64', 'aarch64': 'arm64'}[target_architecture] }}
349	          signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg]
350	          https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code stable main
351	        state: present
352	        filename: vscode
353	        update_cache: true
354	
355	    - name: Install VSCode package
356	      ansible.builtin.apt:
357	        name: code
358	        state: present
359	  rescue:
360	    - name: Warn VSCode install failed
361	      ansible.builtin.debug:
362	        msg: "VSCode install failed — rerun with --tags gui_apps after fixing network/GPG/apt issues."
363	
364	# =============================================================================
365	# Cursor — .deb from cursor.com
366	#
367	# The download API returns a redirect to the latest build for the given
368	# platform. The whole block is tolerant: a failed download is logged but
369	# does not fail the playbook. Users can always fall back to the AppImage
370	# path documented in docs/tools/appimage.md.
371	# =============================================================================
372	
373	- name: Check if Cursor is installed
374	  when:
375	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
376	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
377	  ansible.builtin.command: dpkg -s cursor
378	  register: cursor_check
379	  changed_when: false
380	  failed_when: false
381	
382	- name: Install Cursor via .deb
383	  when:
384	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
385	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
386	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
387	    - cursor_check.rc != 0
388	  become: true
389	  tags: [sudo]
390	  block:
391	    # cursor.com/api/download returns JSON ({downloadUrl, debUrl, rpmUrl, ...}),
392	    # not a redirect to the binary. Must resolve debUrl first, then fetch.
393	    - name: Fetch latest Cursor release metadata
394	      ansible.builtin.uri:
395	        url: >-
396	          https://cursor.com/api/download?platform=linux-{{
397	            {'x86_64': 'x64', 'aarch64': 'arm64'}[target_architecture]
398	          }}&releaseTrack=stable
399	        return_content: true
400	      register: cursor_meta
401	      ignore_errors: true
402	
403	    # downloads.cursor.com routes poorly from GFW-region networks and TCP
404	    # streams frequently drop mid-transfer ("Incomplete read" with partial
405	    # st_size). get_url has no native resume, so retry the whole fetch up
406	    # to 4 times — 4 x 174MB is cheaper than babysitting a failed install.
407	    - name: Download latest Cursor .deb
408	      when:
409	        - cursor_meta is defined
410	        - cursor_meta is succeeded
411	        - cursor_meta.json is defined
412	        - cursor_meta.json.debUrl is defined
413	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
414	        url: "{{ cursor_meta.json.debUrl }}"
415	        dest: /tmp/cursor.deb
416	        mode: '0644'
417	        timeout: 300
418	        force: true
419	      register: cursor_dl
420	      until: cursor_dl is succeeded
421	      retries: 4
422	      delay: 5
423	      ignore_errors: true
424	
425	    - name: Install Cursor .deb
426	      when: cursor_dl is defined and cursor_dl is succeeded
427	      ansible.builtin.apt:
428	        deb: /tmp/cursor.deb
429	        state: present
430	      ignore_errors: true
431	  rescue:
432	    - name: Warn Cursor .deb install failed
433	      ansible.builtin.debug:
434	        msg: >-
435	          Cursor .deb install failed. You can fall back to the AppImage flow —
436	          download from https://cursor.com/download and drop it under
437	          ~/Applications/; AppImageLauncher will auto-integrate. See
438	          docs/tools/appimage.md for the full recipe.
439	
440	# =============================================================================
441	# Discord — channel selectable via discord_channel ansible var (default: flatpak)
442	#
443	# Values (set by .discordChannel chezmoi prompt, plumbed via
444	# .chezmoiscripts/global/run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl):
445	#   - flatpak: Flathub com.discordapp.Discord; auto-updates via `flatpak update`.
446	#              The recommended path — Discord .deb does NOT ship an apt-source
447	#              postinst, so .deb installs require manual re-deploy on every
448	#              release (the in-app updater pops a download modal but cannot
449	#              actually run dpkg). Flatpak side-steps that pain.
450	#   - deb:     Fetch the official .deb; only re-fetches when dpkg -s discord
451	#              fails. Keep this path for users who already standardized on the
452	#              .deb and don't want a Flatpak runtime on disk.
453	#   - none:    Skip — install Discord some other way (Vesktop, web app, etc.).
454	#
455	# Discord upstream only ships amd64 binaries; both .deb and Flathub follow.
456	# armhf is not supported by either path. See
457	# docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.md for the full decision tree.
458	# =============================================================================
459	
460	- name: Set Discord channel default
461	  when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
462	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
463	    discord_channel: "{{ discord_channel | default('flatpak') }}"
464	
465	- name: Warn Discord is amd64-only on Linux (aarch64)
466	  when:
467	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
468	    - target_architecture == 'aarch64'
469	    - discord_channel != 'none'
470	  ansible.builtin.debug:
471	    msg: >-
472	      Discord does not publish official aarch64 binaries (no .deb, no
473	      Flatpak ARM build). Skipping. Use a community build like Vesktop on
474	      ARM64 if you need Discord — see https://github.com/Vencord/Vesktop.
475	
476	# --- deb channel ----------------------------------------------------------
477	
478	- name: Check if Discord .deb is installed
479	  when:
480	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
481	    - target_architecture == 'x86_64'
482	    - discord_channel == 'deb'
483	  ansible.builtin.command: dpkg -s discord
484	  register: discord_check
485	  changed_when: false
486	  failed_when: false
487	
488	- name: Install Discord via .deb
489	  when:
490	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
491	    - target_architecture == 'x86_64'
492	    - discord_channel == 'deb'
493	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
494	    - discord_check.rc != 0
495	  become: true
496	  tags: [sudo]
497	  block:
498	    - name: Download latest Discord .deb (redirect from discord.com)
499	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
500	        url: https://discord.com/api/download?platform=linux&format=deb
501	        dest: /tmp/discord.deb
502	        mode: '0644'
503	        timeout: 300
504	      register: discord_dl
505	      ignore_errors: true
506	
507	    - name: Install Discord .deb
508	      when: discord_dl is defined and discord_dl is succeeded
509	      ansible.builtin.apt:
510	        deb: /tmp/discord.deb
511	        state: present
512	      ignore_errors: true
513	  rescue:
514	    - name: Warn Discord .deb install failed
515	      ansible.builtin.debug:
516	        msg: >-
517	          Discord .deb install failed. Fall back to the official tarball at
518	          https://discord.com/api/download?platform=linux&format=tar.gz
519	          (extract to ~/Applications/Discord/ and wire up a .desktop entry),
520	          or switch to Flatpak by setting discordChannel=flatpak in
521	          ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml.
522	
523	# --- flatpak channel ------------------------------------------------------
524	
525	- name: Install Discord via Flatpak (channel=flatpak)
526	  when:
527	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
528	    - target_architecture == 'x86_64'
529	    - discord_channel == 'flatpak'
530	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
531	  block:
532	    - name: Ensure flatpak package is present
533	      become: true
534	      tags: [sudo]
535	      ansible.builtin.apt:
536	        name: flatpak
537	        state: present
538	        update_cache: true
539	        cache_valid_time: 3600
540	
541	    - name: Ensure Flathub remote is configured (per-user)
542	      community.general.flatpak_remote:
543	        name: flathub
544	        flatpakrepo_url: https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
545	        method: user
546	        state: present
547	
548	    - name: Install Discord from Flathub (per-user)
549	      community.general.flatpak:
550	        name: com.discordapp.Discord
551	        state: present
552	        method: user
553	        remote: flathub
554	  rescue:
555	    - name: Warn Discord Flatpak install failed
556	      ansible.builtin.debug:
557	        msg: >-
558	          Discord Flatpak install failed. Manual fallback —
559	          `flatpak install flathub com.discordapp.Discord` from a shell,
560	          or set discordChannel=deb in ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml to
561	          revert to the .deb path.
562	
563	# =============================================================================
564	# Zen Browser — Firefox-based browser, shipped as an AppImage
565	#
566	# User-level install under ~/Applications/, mirrors the Alacritty pattern for
567	# desktop integration (icon + .desktop entry + update-desktop-database) so
568	# the app is searchable in GNOME/KDE launchers without needing to run the
569	# AppImage once to let AppImageLauncher auto-integrate it.
570	#
571	# noRoot-friendly: the whole block is user-level, no `become: true`, no
572	# `tags: [sudo]`. Works identically in `gui_apps_linux_no_root=true` mode.
573	# =============================================================================
574	
575	- name: Check if Zen AppImage is already installed
576	  when:
577	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
578	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
579	  ansible.builtin.stat:
580	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/zen.AppImage"
581	  register: zen_appimage_check
582	
583	- name: Install Zen Browser AppImage + desktop integration
584	  when:
585	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
586	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
587	    - not zen_appimage_check.stat.exists
588	  block:
589	    - name: Ensure ~/Applications exists (Zen)
590	      ansible.builtin.file:
591	        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications"
592	        state: directory
593	        mode: '0755'
594	
595	    - name: Get latest Zen Browser release metadata
596	      ansible.builtin.uri:
597	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/zen-browser/desktop/releases/latest
598	        return_content: true
599	      register: zen_release
600	
601	    - name: Resolve Zen AppImage asset URL
602	      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
603	        zen_appimage_url: >-
604	          {{ (zen_release.json.assets
605	              | selectattr('name', 'match', '^zen-' + target_architecture + '\\.AppImage$')
606	              | map(attribute='browser_download_url')
607	              | list
608	              | first) | default('') }}
609	
610	    - name: Download Zen AppImage
611	      when: zen_appimage_url | length > 0
612	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
613	        url: "{{ zen_appimage_url }}"
614	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/zen.AppImage"
615	        mode: '0755'
616	        timeout: 300
617	      retries: 3
618	      delay: 5
619	      register: zen_appimage_dl
620	
621	    - name: Download Zen SVG icon
622	      when: zen_appimage_dl is defined and zen_appimage_dl is succeeded
623	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
624	        url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zen-browser/desktop/dev/docs/assets/zen-browser.svg
625	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/zen-browser.svg"
626	        mode: '0644'
627	      retries: 3
628	      delay: 5
629	      ignore_errors: true
630	
631	    - name: Install Zen Browser .desktop entry
632	      when: zen_appimage_dl is defined and zen_appimage_dl is succeeded
633	      ansible.builtin.copy:
634	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/applications/zen-browser.desktop"
635	        mode: '0644'
636	        content: |
637	          [Desktop Entry]
638	          Type=Application
639	          Name=Zen Browser
640	          GenericName=Web Browser
641	          Comment=Experience tranquillity while browsing the web without people tracking you
642	          Exec={{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/zen.AppImage %U
643	          TryExec={{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/zen.AppImage
644	          Icon=zen-browser
645	          Terminal=false
646	          StartupNotify=true
647	          StartupWMClass=zen
648	          Categories=Network;WebBrowser;
649	          MimeType=text/html;text/xml;application/xhtml+xml;application/xml;application/rss+xml;application/rdf+xml;image/gif;image/jpeg;image/png;x-scheme-handler/http;x-scheme-handler/https;x-scheme-handler/ftp;x-scheme-handler/chrome;video/webm;application/x-xpinstall;
650	          Keywords=web;browser;internet;firefox;zen;
651	
652	    - name: Refresh desktop application database (Zen)
653	      when: zen_appimage_dl is defined and zen_appimage_dl is succeeded
654	      ansible.builtin.command: update-desktop-database "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/applications"
655	      changed_when: false
656	      failed_when: false
657	  rescue:
658	    - name: Warn Zen install failed
659	      ansible.builtin.debug:
660	        msg: >-
661	          Zen Browser install failed — you can fall back to downloading the
662	          AppImage manually from https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/releases/latest
663	          into ~/Applications/ and re-running `update-desktop-database ~/.local/share/applications`.
664	
665	# =============================================================================
666	# Antigravity (placeholder)
667	# No official Linux build at the time of writing; leave the hook disabled so
668	# the structure is obvious when upstream starts shipping a .deb or AppImage.
669	# =============================================================================
670	
671	- name: Antigravity Linux install (disabled — no official Linux build yet)
672	  when: false
673	  ansible.builtin.debug:
674	    msg: >-
675	      TODO: when an official Antigravity Linux .deb or AppImage ships,
676	      add install tasks here mirroring the Cursor block above.
677	
678	# =============================================================================
679	# CopyQ — clipboard manager with scriptable CLI (`copyq read/select/eval/...`)
680	#
681	# Stock Ubuntu apt repos ship copyq on 22.04 (15.0 since 24.04, 4.x on 22.04),
682	# both new enough for the `cb`/`cbl`/`cbe` helper at
683	# dot_config/shell/56_clipboard_history.sh. No third-party PPA or .deb needed.
684	#
685	# Daemon autostart is shipped by the package as
686	# /etc/xdg/autostart/com.github.hluk.copyq.desktop — no systemd-user unit.
687	#
688	# macOS counterpart is Maccy (see Brewfile.darwin.tmpl); the helper detects
689	# whichever backend is installed at shell-startup time. Reason for the split:
690	# the CopyQ Homebrew cask is deprecated (disabled 2026-09-01) because
691	# CopyQ.app isn't signed for Gatekeeper — only the cask, not the project.
692	# =============================================================================
693	
694	- name: Install CopyQ via apt (stock repos)
695	  when:
696	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
697	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
698	  become: true
699	  tags: [sudo]
700	  ansible.builtin.apt:
701	    name: copyq
702	    state: present
703	    update_cache: false
704	
705	# =============================================================================
706	# App-control utilities — CLI tools used by `dot_config/shell/56_linux_apps.sh`
707	# (the app-* helpers: appquit / applaunch / appactivate / apprestart /
708	# apprunning / applist / appresponsive) and the `tv linux-apps` channel.
709	#
710	# Why each:
711	#   - playerctl  MPRIS CLI — appresponsive's only meaningful probe for media
712	#                players (Spotify, mpv, VLC, Firefox). The one cross-DE bright
713	#                spot for "is this app actually alive and answering."
714	#   - wmctrl     X11 window control. No-op on Wayland but cheap (~50KB) and
715	#                still useful if the user falls back to an X11 session.
716	#   - xdotool    X11 window + input control. Same Wayland caveat as wmctrl.
717	#
718	# GNOME `window-calls` extension is NOT automated here — it can't be silenced
719	# on GNOME 46+ (user consent dialog) and is a one-time manual step documented
720	# in docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.md → "Controlling installed apps".
721	# =============================================================================
722	
723	- name: Install app-control CLI utilities (playerctl, wmctrl, xdotool)
724	  when:
725	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
726	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
727	  become: true
728	  tags: [sudo, app_control]
729	  ansible.builtin.apt:
730	    name:
731	      - playerctl
732	      - wmctrl
733	      - xdotool
734	    state: present
735	    update_cache: false
736

10

13	    path: /usr/local/bin/brew

15

23	    msg: "Homebrew not installed. It should be installed by bootstrap script."
24	
25	# Only update if FETCH_HEAD is older than 24 h — brew update is a slow git fetch
26	# and upgrade_tools.sh brew already runs it on explicit upgrade runs.
27	- name: Check when Homebrew was last updated
28	  when: homebrew_installed
29	  ansible.builtin.stat:
30	    path: "{{ homebrew_arm.stat.exists | ternary('/opt/homebrew', '/usr/local/Homebrew') }}/.git/FETCH_HEAD"
31	  register: brew_fetch_head
32	
33	- name: Update Homebrew
34	  when:
35	    - homebrew_installed
36	    - not brew_fetch_head.stat.exists or (lookup('pipe', 'date +%s') | int - brew_fetch_head.stat.mtime | int) > 86400
37	  community.general.homebrew:
38	    update_homebrew: true
39	  ignore_errors: true
40	
41	# Skip cleanup on the same 24 h window as brew update — no new installs = nothing to clean.
42	- name: Clean up stale Homebrew versions and links
43	  when:
44	    - homebrew_installed
45	    - not brew_fetch_head.stat.exists or (lookup('pipe', 'date +%s') | int - brew_fetch_head.stat.mtime | int) > 86400
46	  ansible.builtin.command: brew cleanup
47	  changed_when: false
48	  ignore_errors: true

194	# --- OpenTofu via official deb repo ---
195	- name: Install OpenTofu from official repo (Debian/Ubuntu)
196	  when:
197	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
198	    - iac_install_opentofu
199	  become: true
200	  tags: [sudo]
201	  block:
202	    - name: Install OpenTofu prerequisites
203	      ansible.builtin.apt:
204	        name:
205	          - curl
206	          - gnupg
207	        state: present
208	
209	    - name: Create keyrings directory for OpenTofu
210	      ansible.builtin.file:
211	        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
212	        state: directory
213	        mode: '0755'
214	
215	    # Single-key setup: the `InRelease` file is signed by the key at
216	    # packages.opentofu.org/.../gpgkey (subkey 70DF59811A8B9109). The old
217	    # dual-key approach also included get.opentofu.org/opentofu.gpg, but that
218	    # is an unrelated OpenTofu project key that does NOT sign the repo —
219	    # carrying it in signed-by= bought nothing. `deb-src` is dropped because
220	    # this Cloudsmith-style repo has no source packages and apt-get update
221	    # fails on the missing Sources file.
222	    - name: Install OpenTofu repo and package
223	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
224	        set -eo pipefail
225	        # gpg --dearmor -o <file> refuses to overwrite without --yes; on a
226	        # re-apply the keyring file exists from the previous run. Use --yes
227	        # so the task is idempotent.
228	        curl -fsSL https://packages.opentofu.org/opentofu/tofu/gpgkey \
229	          | gpg --no-tty --batch --yes --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/opentofu.gpg
230	        # Clean up the orphan keyring from the old dual-key layout so a
231	        # stale sources.list entry referencing it cannot wedge apt-get update.
232	        rm -f /etc/apt/keyrings/opentofu-repo.gpg
233	        echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/opentofu.gpg] https://packages.opentofu.org/opentofu/tofu/any/ any main" \
234	          > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/opentofu.list
235	        apt-get update
236	        apt-get install -y tofu
237	      args:
238	        executable: /bin/bash
239	      changed_when: true

8	#     expose their entry points in ~/.local/bin (e.g. jupyter-core to get
9	#     the `jupyter` meta-CLI; `notebook` to get `jupyter-notebook`)
10	#     NOTE: requires uv >= 0.8.5 (--with-executables-from added in that release)
11	#     For the meta-CLI dispatch model + the 8 jupyter binaries this exposes,
12	#     see docs/tools/notebooks.md "The `jupyter` meta-CLI vs standalone binaries".
13	#     For the auto-upgrade dispatch when uv is too old, see docs/this_repo/uv-bootstrap.md.
14	#   - extra_binaries: (optional) list of additional binary names that must
15	#     also exist in ~/.local/bin for the install to be considered complete.
16	#     Use this whenever `with_executables_from` is set, so adding a new
17	#     entry-point package later triggers a `--force` reinstall on machines
18	#     that already have `binary` present from a prior apply. Without this,
19	#     ansible's `creates:` guard short-circuits the install command and the
20	#     new exec shims are never written. See

10	# would be impractical for these packages (ffmpeg / imagemagick / libvips
11	# all want C compilers + system codecs).

50	  tags: [sudo]

52	    name:
53	      - nmap
54	      - arp-scan
55	      - mtr
56	      - iperf3
57	      - httpie
58	      - tcpdump
59	    state: present

61	# --- system-level packages (yum/CentOS 7+) ---
62	# yum CLI for CentOS 7 compat — see pitfalls/centos7-ansible-yum-dnf-backend.md
63	- name: Install networking tools from yum (RedHat/CentOS) — yum CLI for CentOS 7 + Rocky/Alma compat
64	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "RedHat"
65	  become: true
66	  tags: [sudo]
67	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
68	    set -e
69	    missing=()
70	    for p in nmap arp-scan mtr iperf3 tcpdump; do
71	      rpm -q "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$p")
72	    done
73	    # NOTE: httpie is in EPEL on CentOS 7 and pip-installed via uv elsewhere
74	    # if missing, so we skip it here to avoid hard-requiring EPEL.
75	    if [ -z "${missing[*]:-}" ]; then

77	      exit 0

80	  args:
81	    executable: /bin/bash
82	  register: networking_yum_result
83	  changed_when: "'ALL_INSTALLED' not in networking_yum_result.stdout"
84	  ignore_errors: true

89	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
90	    net_arch_deb: >-
91	      {{
92	        'amd64' if target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
93	        else 'arm64' if target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
94	        else target_architecture
95	      }}

99	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
100	  ansible.builtin.command: doggo --version
101	  register: doggo_check
102	  changed_when: false
103	  failed_when: false

106	  when:
107	    - ansible_facts["os_family"] in ["Debian", "RedHat"]
108	    - doggo_check.rc != 0
109	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64', 'aarch64', 'arm64']

114	        state: directory

120	        return_content: true

132	            else 'arm64' if target_architecture in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
133	            else target_architecture
134	          }}
135	
136	    - name: Download doggo tarball
137	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
138	        url: "https://github.com/mr-karan/doggo/releases/download/{{ doggo_release.json.tag_name }}/doggo_{{ doggo_version }}_Linux_{{ doggo_arch }}.tar.gz"
139	        dest: /tmp/doggo.tar.gz
140	        mode: '0644'
141	        timeout: 120

143	      delay: 5

量測完成。`nvim` 1.7GB 確認是累積的 (lazy plugins 1.2GB + mason LSP 483MB),不是 config 本身。我有足夠資料了。

下面是評估結果。

---

## 整體磁碟佔用評估

先講方法論:這台機器 (macOS Apple Silicon) 是**已長期重度使用、且開了不少 opt-in role 的 power-user 機器**,所以實測值是**上界**。我把它跟「全新輕量機只開 default-on」的推估並列,你才看得出 config 本身的重量 vs 累積快取的重量。

### A. 本機實測 — 各模塊佔用(上界)

| 模塊 | 路徑 | 實測 | 性質 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Homebrew formulae | `Cellar` | **6.1 GB** | macOS 專屬;含 gcc 442M、gemini-cli 433M、azure-cli 427M、code-server、pandoc、go、duckdb… |
| uv Python CLI 工具 | `~/.local/share/uv/tools` | **4.0 GB** | 但其中 aider 541M、ansible 283M、arxiv-mcp 70M 是你手動裝的,**不在 role 內** |
| mise 語言 runtime | `mise/installs` | **2.0 GB** | node 1.2G + dotnet 653M + ruby 118M + bun 57M |
| Neovim 外掛+LSP | `~/.local/share/nvim` | **1.7 GB** | lazy 1.2G + mason 483M — **累積出來的,非 config 本身** |
| npm global | `node/.../node_modules` | **1.1 GB** | coding agents (gemini/codex/copilot) + readability-cli |
| cargo 工具+registry | `~/.cargo` | 864 MB | registry cache 59M |
| Homebrew Casks (GUI) | `Caskroom` | 690 MB | desktop profile 才有 |
| uv Python 直譯器 | `uv/python` | 336 MB | 共享,主要一份 3.13 |
| Docker (OrbStack 控制層) | — | ~141 MB | 不含你拉的 image/volume |
| oh-my-zsh / 字型 / gems | — | ~85 MB | nerd fonts 34M、omz 29M、gems 20M |

**實測合計 ≈ 17 GB**(不含 repo 自身 `.git` 110MB、`site/` 32MB 產生物、以及 docker images)。

### B. 「全新輕量機 + 只開 default-on」推估

把 gated 的 role 關掉(`auditd` / `bitwarden` / `iac_tools` / `input_method` / `llm_tools` / `dotnet_tools` / AI desktop casks),Linux server profile 無 GUI、無 Homebrew(走 apt + GitHub release 靜態 binary):

| 區塊 | 推估 | 主要佔用 |
|---|---:|---|
| uv default 工具 | **~1.8 GB** | **marimo 855M + jupyterlab 426M + sqlit-tui 356M** 三者就佔九成 |
| mise runtime | ~1.0–1.6 GB | rust toolchain + node + bun(關掉 dotnet 省 650M) |
| devtools 靜態 binary (~40 個) | ~0.5–1 GB | bat/eza/delta/yazi/zellij/btop/duckdb… 多為單檔 |
| Neovim(首次 sync 後) | ~0.3–0.5 GB | 之後隨用隨長 |
| npm 全域 (coding agents) | ~0.3 GB | gemini-cli/codex |
| uv python 直譯器 + 字型 + 雜項 | ~0.4 GB | |

**輕量預設合計 ≈ 4–6 GB**(全新、未累積)。

---

## 結論:會不會太 heavy?

**對一般開發筆電(256GB+)不算重**;但若「輕量」指的是小 VPS / 20–30GB 容器 / 樹莓派,則**偏重**,而且重量集中在幾個不成比例的點:

1. **uv 的資料科學三件套 marimo + jupyterlab + sqlit-tui ≈ 1.6 GB** — 這是 `python_uv_tools` default-on 裡最肥的,但不是每台 dev 機都需要 notebook。這是最值得改成 opt-in 的一塊。
2. **mise rust + dotnet runtime ≈ 1.3 GB** — dotnet 已經是 gated(好),rust toolchain 若不做 rust 開發是純浪費。
3. **macOS 的 Homebrew Cellar 6.1 GB** — 因為 brew formula 帶完整依賴樹(gcc/icu/python 各自一份),這是 macOS 路徑天生比 Linux 靜態 binary 路徑肥 3–4 倍的主因。
4. **nvim 1.7 GB 是假象** — config 本身幾 KB,胖的是 lazy/mason 自動下載 + 隨用累積,任何 LazyVim 都這樣,不算這套 dotfiles 的「設定重量」。

**可拉的瘦身槓桿(repo 已有的機制):**
- `scripts/init/dotfiles_init.py` 的 **`minimal` bundle**(CI/Docker 用)已經是輕量入口 — 強制關 vim mode、跳過重 role。
- 把 `marimo` / `jupyterlab` / `sqlit-tui` 從 `python_uv_tools` default 移到一個 `installDataScience` prompt 後面,輕量預設立省 ~1.6GB。
- 不做 rust 開發就從 `mise [tools]` 拿掉 `rust@latest`。

要不要我把「default uv 工具偏重、建議 gate 掉 notebook 三件套」這條記進 `TODO.md` / `backlog/`(用 project-knowledge-harness),當成一個之後評估的瘦身項目?或是你想要我寫一支腳本,讓你能在任一台機器跑出像上面 A 表那樣的實測明細?
